name: emit digits of a constant one at a time from a bounded carry state
mechanism: represent the constant as a series in a mixed-radix form, keep only the current remainders of each term, and at each step multiply through by the output base and carry to release the next digit; earlier digits are never stored or reused

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Spigot algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions: a way to compute the value of a mathematical constant without knowing preceding digits
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bailey–Borwein–Plouffe formula': (BBP formula) a spigot algorithm for the computation of the nth binary digit of π

requires: a series with rational terms for the constant
fails_when: quadratic in the digit count for the classic form
